what: Table 10 web page now has a live Unreal camera stream and two real-arm link tests (Move up, Go to idle); virtual and real arms shown synced in mirror mode.
why: User request: test the bridge between the real Maker Arms and virtual Table 10, sync positions first, and drive both with test buttons while watching a live stream.
details: Mirror mode: virtual Table 10 copies the real arms; page shows virtual-vs-real error (0.0 deg left/right at first check).
Move up raises both grippers 8 cm straight up; Go to idle returns to the folded rest [0,-6,6,0,0,0] deg (the fleet idle pose is outside the real joint-4 range). Peak 0.35 rad/s, inside motor limits.
Real arms follow only after the operator switches real_arm_bridge.py to drive at its terminal; tests are refused in mirror mode. Nine-table simulations paused at the user's request.
